checkout.pricing.hero.title: Start loyalty operations through plan activation
checkout.pricing.hero.body: Timeblock centralizes member missions, event participation, internal point ledgers, TBQR tracking, AI usage allowance and API integration. Member and business plans are activated through separate flows, and all permissions become effective after operations review.
checkout.pricing.orbit.ledger.label: Activity ledger
checkout.pricing.orbit.tbqr.label: TBQR
checkout.pricing.orbit.api.label: Enterprise API
checkout.pricing.process.title: Payment and activation process
checkout.pricing.process.body: After selecting a plan, the system creates a payment request. After the required amount is transferred and transaction data is submitted, Timeblock operations reviews it manually; plan permissions activate only after approval.
checkout.pricing.payment_status.title: Payment method status
checkout.pricing.payment_status.body: USDT payment is currently supported. PayPal checkout is under review and is not open before formal activation.
checkout.pricing.member.title: Let members use internal points for more platform benefits
checkout.pricing.member.body: Paid member plans unlock event, affiliate and platform benefit quotas. Internal points are not cash and cannot be withdrawn as cash.
checkout.pricing.business.title: Activate enterprise-level loyalty and event operations
checkout.pricing.business.body: Business plans unlock event, affiliate, TBQR, API and Webhook quotas. Business permissions are reviewed and activated by Timeblock admin and do not bypass ledger, governance or risk-control rules.
checkout.pricing.free.name: Free member
checkout.pricing.free.body: Suitable for members starting missions, joining events, using basic AI chat allowance and browsing platform benefits.
checkout.pricing.wallet.title: Receiving addresses are confirmed only in payment requests
checkout.pricing.wallet.body: Use the network, amount and receiving address shown in the payment request. BEP20 is the current default network; do not switch to a different network manually.
checkout.pricing.activation.title: Activation rules
checkout.pricing.activation.body: Plan permissions activate only after operations confirms the payment request. Every confirmation is written to payment review and entitlement audit records for future operational tracking.
checkout.plan.member_basic.name: Advanced member
checkout.plan.member_basic.description: Suitable for members who consistently participate in missions, events and platform benefits. Upgrade to unlock member event creation, small affiliate access, member short-link QR and basic Internal FGO conversion quota.
checkout.plan.member_vip.name: VIP member
checkout.plan.member_vip.description: Suitable for high-frequency trusted members who need higher event quotas and priority review benefits. Provides higher limits for events, affiliate access, member short-link QR and Internal FGO conversion.
checkout.plan.business_project_partner.d: Suitable for projects connected to Timeblock or growth-stage enterprises, used to activate business events, partner affiliate, TBQR tracking and API integration readiness.
checkout.plan.business_enterprise.name: Enterprise customer plan
checkout.plan.business_enterprise.descri: Suitable for enterprise teams that need large-scale member operations, event governance, QR attribution, API/Webhook management and higher support levels.
checkout.intent.hero_body: Follow the USDT amount, payment network and receiving address shown on this page, then submit the transaction hash for operations review.
checkout.intent.paypal_unavailable: PayPal checkout is under review and temporarily unavailable
checkout.intent.payment_details.title: Payment details
checkout.intent.proof.title: Submit transaction proof
checkout.intent.proof.body: Use the exact amount and network shown on this page. Incorrect network or amount may fail review and will not automatically activate benefits.
checkout.intent.proof.tx_placeholder: Paste the transaction hash after completing the USDT transfer
checkout.intent.proof.note_placeholder: Payment wallet, amount, transfer time or block explorer note
checkout.intent.proof.closed: This payment request no longer accepts payment proof updates.
checkout.intent.review.title: Review process
checkout.intent.review.body: Admin reviews the transaction hash, payment network, amount, plan and note. After confirmation, Timeblock activates the corresponding member or business benefits and writes an activation audit record.
checkout.intent.activation.title: Activation status
checkout.intent.activation.done: This payment request has been activated.
checkout.intent.activation.pending: Not activated yet. Submit payment proof first and wait for admin confirmation.
checkout.status.proof_submitted: Payment proof submitted. Please wait for operations review.
checkout.pricing.payment_status.manual: USDT is available. PayPal is temporarily available as a manual payment: send payment to the displayed PayPal email, submit the PayPal transaction reference, and wait for admin verification.
checkout.intent.paypal_manual.hero_body: Send the payment to the PayPal email shown below, then submit the PayPal transaction ID or reference. Admin verifies the payment manually before activation.
checkout.intent.paypal_manual.no_automat: Manual review only; no PayPal API capture or webhook is active.
checkout.intent.paypal_manual.admin_chec: admin checks PayPal amount and currency manually
checkout.intent.paypal_manual.proof_body: After sending the PayPal payment, enter the PayPal transaction ID or reference and include the paid amount and currency in the note. Admin will review it manually.
checkout.intent.paypal_manual.reference_: Paste the PayPal transaction ID or reference
checkout.intent.paypal_manual.note_place: Include the paid amount, currency, sender email and payment time
checkout.intent.paypal_manual.review_bod: The admin receives an email when proof is submitted, checks the PayPal account manually, and then confirms or rejects the request. No entitlement is activated automatically.
